_doc: issue #1083 P1 semantic oracle. Format-independent (survives the CSV->NDJSON interchange flip): expected loader-visible membership + feed/group/log attribution, hand-transcribed from reading golden_pfb_py_zone.txt/golden_pfb_py_data.txt and feeds.json -- never computed from those files by the code under test.

manifest_attribution._doc: Per corpus feed (tests/fixtures/dnsbl_corpus/feeds.json), one representative domain build() places in data_db/zone_db/white_db, with its expected {feed, group} resolved through feed_group_index_db, hand-derived from feeds.json's header/group columns. 'log' is asserted only where the entry type carries it: every plain-path/ABP-reconciled block entry carries 'log' (every corpus feed logs '1'); a permit-mode allow (white_db) carries 'index' but NEVER 'log'. wirecap_feed's domain is the 253-char wire-cap boundary name -- computed in the test (same construction as _NAME_253 in test_adr62_byte_identity_corpus.py/test_adr62_parity_oracle.py), not spelled out here. oversized_feed is deliberately absent: every one of its lines is wire-cap-rejected before index_for() ever runs (#752), so it claims no index at all -- not a coverage gap.
